title: Animated Dialog
subtitle: A window over the page that asks for a decision before you carry on.

descriptions.rollingText: The trigger and button labels roll to a second copy on hover.
descriptions.fillOnHover: Buttons fill with colour from the edge on hover.
descriptions.originFromTrigger: The dialog grows out of the button that opened it instead of the centre.
descriptions.elastic: The dialog springs in with a slight overshoot.
descriptions.duration: How long the open animation takes, in seconds.
descriptions.bounce: How much the dialog overshoots and settles. 0 is no bounce.
descriptions.fadeContent: Fades the dialog contents in as it opens.
descriptions.scaleContent: Scales the dialog contents up with the dialog.
descriptions.exitAnimation: How the dialog leaves: fades, drops down, or shrinks.
descriptions.fadeContentOut: Fades the contents out when the dialog closes.
descriptions.dismissible: Clicking outside the dialog closes it. When off, the dialog shakes instead if Shake when blocked is on.
descriptions.shakeOnBlock: The dialog shakes when you click outside and it can't close.
descriptions.backdrop: What sits behind the dialog: nothing, a dim layer, or a blur.
